title: Pipe flow start-up
line: A transient flow FEA study of oil in a 10 mm line starting from rest under a step pressure.
description: Start-up of laminar flow of ISO VG 46 oil in a 10 mm bore, 300 mm long, with 807 Pa applied across it at t = 0. The study samples the mean oil speed through the first 0.6 s; Szymanski's solution puts 95 % of the final 0.21 m/s at 0.28 s.
thumbnailAlt: Oil speed building up in a 10 mm line after a step pressure, solved in RunMat
